scope: Only anonymous latitude–season parameter space; no B16 map georeferencing, actual Orbina latitude, radius, atmosphere, stellar flux or adopted period.

surface_archetypes.label: 抽象海洋型热惯性与水汽源
抽象陆地型热响应与水汽源

method.solar: Daily mean incident Q/S0=(H0sin(phi)sin(delta)+cos(phi)cos(delta)sin(H0))/pi, H0=acos(-tan(phi)tan(delta)) with polar day-night limits H0=pi or 0. Circular orbit assumed. This is solar geometry, not total flux W/m2.
method.solar_declination: delta=asin(sin(obliquity)*sin(2*pi*(phase_index-1)/12)); equinox phase1, north solstice phase4, south solstice phase10.
method.circulation_width: heuristic low-latitude W=clamp(34/sqrt(relative angular velocity),22,52); not derived GCM physics
method.polar_front: illustrative boundary=clamp(67+4*(1-omega_ratio),61,71) degrees; not a measured jet stream
method.ascent: subsolar declination times heuristic rotation response clamp(.98-.19*(omega_ratio-.55),.67,1)
method.wind: Dimensionless eastward-positive westward-negative zonal tendency, banded by low/mid/high latitudes, no wind speeds
method.rain: Gaussian rising air and reference midlatitude stormtrack proxy minus subtropical sinking term, moisture scaling ocean .88 and land .55, clipped 0..1; not mass-conserving or real precipitation
method.thermal: Solar anomaly vs latitude 12-period average; ocean weighted current/previous/two-back 0.42/0.37/0.21 gain .82, land weighted current/previous .86/.14 gain 1.24; NOT actual degrees Celsius
method.surface_warning: Ocean and land are unmapped extreme examples, not surface coverage or coordinates.

limitations: All 9 scenarios are noncanon; comparing spin and tilt is factorial not official parameter selection
Q/S0 solar geometry meaningful only conditional on circular orbit and tilted spin axis, stellar flux remains unspecified
Hadley width, tropical ascent, zonal winds, thermal and precipitation fields are heuristic teaching models, NOT GCM
Planet size gravity atmospheric chemistry and actual heat capacity missing. No real climate or wind statistics.
No official river, sea, city or nation is assigned latitude, rainfall or monsoonal season.
No claim Orbina has a 12-month calendar. Phases are normalized orbital steps.
